context: Sho-young rides bike for first time without training wheels; Daichi watches.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お父さん、自転車、動かす!
lines.en: Dad, my bike — make it go!
lines.style: Bright, urgent whisper of excitement. Quick intake of breath at the start. Bouncing on the balls of his feet in his voice. Pure, unguarded joy.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.en: Yeah, just give it a go — pedal easy.
lines.style: Warm, encouraging Kansai drawl. Leans in close. Soft and steady, the way you'd steady a nervous animal. Pride already in his voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 上手く乗れたら、嬉しい!
lines.en: If I can do it… I'll be so happy.
lines.style: Tentative hope underneath. Quiet concentration mixed with anticipation. Holds his breath a little, testing the words as much as the pedals.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.style: Sudden delight breaking through. Sharp recognition on the first word. Warm, amazed Kansai lift. The pride of a father watching something click.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 止まったら、また始める!
lines.en: If I stop, I'll just start again.
lines.style: Small, determined voice. Matter-of-fact but not resigned — the logic of a six-year-old who's decided something matters. Steadiness where doubt could be.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: お父さん、応援、ずっとや!
lines.en: Dad's right here with you — always.
lines.style: Deep, tender Kansai warmth. Slight rasp of emotion held back carefully. Each word deliberate, a promise whispered rather than shouted. Present tense made eternal.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Quiet, genuine gratitude. No performance. Small smile audible in the voice. The kind of 'thank you' that means everything.
